notes: Independent Frostadamus Classic TBC video study transcribed by Synful-Syn in the cited GitHub issue; original video timestamp 11m47s. Counts are aggregate quality-tier GEM UNITS, not material-specific identities or per-cast positive outcomes. Source says 1,000 ore / 200 five-ore prospects but does not provide a verified completed click/event log, refund handling, skill, specialization, build, rank, 0/1/2 histograms, or source data date. The 200 is a nominal operation equivalent, NOT a validated cast denominator; casts intentionally null. Do not merge with Diary of a Guild Leader's 3,000/29,865 ore cohort or a private-server reproduction. Historical TBC Classic evidence only; no live Retail applicability or gold valuation inferred.
outputName: Any rare-quality Outland gem (pooled tier, item identities unspecified)
